preconditions.description: The length of the string s is between 1 and 500,000.
The string s has exactly n characters.

postconditions.description: The output is less than or equal to the length of the string s.

postconditions.expression: all(s[i:].startswith(t) and len(t) < len(s[i:]) for i in range(n) for t in [s[i:]] if s[i:] != t)
postconditions.description: The output represents a journey where each string in the journey is a substring of the previous string and the length of each string is strictly less than the length of the previous string.
